notes.title: CC Patch Version 0.15 Text To Speech
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]Update to all units AI[/b] pathfinding, targeting and combat now all use less resources having max population battles runs much smoother.
[*] [b]Internal Text To Speech System[/b] Implemented across Menus and gameplay, press "scan button" on large camera to have system read out all friendly and enemy units totals in each of 9 quadrants. Use small camera on example 4.5 press scan to have system read out amount of each unit type for player and AI.
[*] [b]Pointer system[/b] added now on selected menu you can move left to right over unit type and press "set_waypoint" key to remove one of selected unit type from active group.
[*] [b]Building System[/b] Added both player and AI now have to pay one time costs to unlock better technology and enable elite units being built.
[*] Bugs squashed everywhere pause menu mouse navigation fixed, background music is now picked truly randomly ect ect.
[/list]

This is a major patch that's been in the works for a while debugging this has been a constant battle will fix any errors or edge cases as they appear.

notes.title: CC Patch Version 0.14
notes.content:
[list]
[*] In game options screen now available on all levels with full functionality, changes immediately applied.
[*] On levels where not all cameras are available when unavailable camera is selected, minimap appears for short duration showing which sections are available.
[*] Population count added for player and AI with weighted values for each unit.
[*] Two new songs added and music system overhauled to stop songs overlapping.
[*] Objective hints have been removed from LVL 1 due to obtrusiveness.
[*] Loading screen logic improved reducing crashes, and clear visual indicator that scenes are changing currently only a fade to black effect and text unique background images to be added.
[*] General bug fixes ect.
[/list]

notes.title: CC Patch Version 0.13 Sprites no longer moonwalk !
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Pleased to announce all units now have improved logic for determining which animated sprites to play very pleased with results, next challenge is expanding AI enemy to better manage multiple active unit groups with different priorities!
[*] New Options added Full screen, Borderless and Vsync
[*] Cleaning up the code base quite a few redundant files removed.
[*] Fixed my mistake where a few labels were not updating with your text colour and shadow preference.
[/list]

notes.title: Calrivar Cluster Patch Version 0.12
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Fully rebindable keys with two separate profiles on for traditional keyboard controls and one focused on Number Pad Controls, however you have complete freedom and can assign any key to either profile. Any changes to your control profiles is saved and loaded for future gameplay sessions.
[*] Save issues fixed previously your audio levels would reset to maximum upon restarting the game, preferences are now saved and loaded correctly.
[*] Tutorial glitch fixed which when triggered could make level impossible to complete, and slight changes to tutorial to make it a better experience.
[/olist]

notes.title: Calrivar Cluster Patch Version 0.11
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Tutorial expanded to better cover core mechanics and be more interactive.
[*] Audio bugs fixed, when setting audio levels for background music and in game audio setting volume below -5 decibel's stopped all audio even when slider was brought back up this is now fixed.
[*] Bug on some menu screens occasionally caused game to enter a empty screen the only way out was to close game this is now fixed.
[*] Next update on the way dealing with in game logic issues, thankyou for your patience.
[/olist]
